name: English Bay Beach (First Beach)
description: Vancouver's most iconic downtown beach, located along Beach Avenue and Denman Street with direct Stanley Park seawall access.
parkingInfo: Pay parking along Beach Ave and Denman St. Limited city lots.
transitInfo: Bus #5 (Robson) or #6 (Davie) directly to Denman and Davie.

name: Kitsilano Beach (Kits Beach)
description: One of Vancouver's most vibrant coastal parks with wide sandy shores, outdoor basketball and volleyball courts, and the famed saltwater Kits Pool.
parkingInfo: Paid lots adjacent to Kits Pool and Arbutus St.
transitInfo: Bus #2, #4, or #7 along Cornwall or 4th Ave.

name: Sunset Beach
advisoryReason: Elevated single-sample bacterial count following False Creek tidal exchange. Resampling in progress.
description: Situated at the mouth of False Creek near the Burrard Street Bridge, known for peaceful sunsets and quiet waters.
parkingInfo: Paid parking lot at Beach Ave and Thurlow St.
transitInfo: Bus #23 (Beach) or Aquabus / False Creek Ferry from Granville Island.

latestSample.notes: Single sample 280 CFU/100mL triggered Beach Action Value. Resampling scheduled.

name: Jericho Beach
description: Expansive sandy beach with grassy picnic lawns, the Jericho Sailing Centre, and wide open views of the North Shore mountains.
parkingInfo: Large paid lot off Point Grey Road / Wallace St.
transitInfo: Bus #4 (UBC) to 4th Ave and Wallace, 5 min walk north.

name: Spanish Banks West
description: Designated quiet beach zone where amplified music is restricted. Massive low-tide sandflats and dedicated off-leash dog area.
parkingInfo: Free city parking lots along NW Marine Drive (fill quickly on hot weekends).
transitInfo: Bus #4 or #84 connecting to UBC exchanges.

name: Spanish Banks East
description: Popular family area with grassy shade spots, beach volleyball nets, and expansive tidal shallows at low tide.
parkingInfo: Free lots along NW Marine Drive.
transitInfo: Bus #4 / #84 to NW Marine Dr & Tolmie St.

name: Spanish Banks Extension
description: The westernmost stretch of Spanish Banks, featuring rugged coastal sand flats, kitesurfer launches, and an expansive off-leash pet area.
parkingInfo: Free gravel parking lot along NW Marine Drive extension.
transitInfo: Bus #4 to Blanca loop, then bike or walk west.

name: Locarno Beach
description: Designated quiet beach bordered by stately evergreen trees and tall grass dunes, ideal for reading and restful swim sessions.
parkingInfo: Free parking lot off NW Marine Drive near Trimble St.
transitInfo: Bus #4 along 4th Ave to Trimble St, walk 6 min north.

name: Second Beach (Stanley Park)
description: Located on the southwestern edge of Stanley Park next to Second Beach outdoor heated pool, pitch & putt, and playground.
parkingInfo: Stanley Park paid parking lots at Stanley Park Drive / Lagoon Drive.
transitInfo: Bus #19 into Stanley Park loop, then 10 min walk.

name: Third Beach (Stanley Park)
description: Secluded, natural beach nestled in Ferguson Point with dense rainforest backdrop, drumming circles, and breathtaking ocean sunsets.
parkingInfo: Paid lot at Ferguson Point / Teahouse in Stanley Park.
transitInfo: Bus #19 to Stanley Park loop, 20 min scenic forest walk or seawall bike.

name: Trout Lake Beach (John Hendry Park)
advisoryReason: 30-day geometric mean is 245 E. coli / 100 mL, exceeding recreational threshold (200 CFU/100mL). Active swimming advisory.
description: East Vancouver's sole freshwater swimming lake set in the heart of John Hendry Park with dog park and community centre.
parkingInfo: Free parking lot off Victoria Drive and 15th Ave.
transitInfo: Commercial-Broadway SkyTrain station, 8 min walk south.

latestSample.notes: Elevated bacteria due to high lake water temps and waterfowl presence. Advisory active.

name: CRAB Park Beach
description: Portside green space overlooking the working harbor, Helijet pad, and container terminals with an off-leash dog area.
parkingInfo: Pay parking lot at end of Main Street / Waterfront Road.
transitInfo: Waterfront SkyTrain station, 8 min walk via overpass.

name: Hadden Park (Kits Dog Beach)
description: Vancouver's most beloved off-leash dog beach, adjacent to the Maritime Museum and Kits Beach with grassy bluffs and sandy tidal flats.
parkingInfo: Paid parking lots at Maritime Museum and Kits Beach.
transitInfo: Bus #2 along Cornwall, 5 min walk north.

name: Tower Beach (UBC / Trail 3)
description: Rugged, pebbled beach named after WWII searchlight watchtowers, accessed via Pacific Spirit Park trail stairs.
parkingInfo: Paid parking lots at UBC North Parkade or Marine Drive meter spots.
transitInfo: Bus #4, #99 B-Line, or #84 to UBC Exchange, walk to Trail 3.

name: Wreck Beach (Trail 6)
description: North America's largest and most celebrated clothing-optional beach, framed by dramatic cliffs and 500 wooden forest steps.
parkingInfo: Paid parking meters along NW Marine Drive or UBC parkades.
transitInfo: Bus #4, #99 B-Line, #44 to UBC Bus Exchange, walk 8 min to Trail 6 entrance.

name: Ambleside Beach
description: Premier West Vancouver waterfront park with sandy beach, Lions Gate Bridge views, par-3 golf, skatepark, and expansive dog park.
parkingInfo: Multiple free lots throughout Ambleside Park (entrance at 13th St).
transitInfo: Bus #250 / #257 from Downtown Vancouver across Lions Gate Bridge.

name: Dundarave Beach
description: Charming village beach at the west end of the Millennium Centennial Seawalk with a historic pier, beach house bistro, and wading pool.
parkingInfo: Street parking along Marine Drive and 25th Street.
transitInfo: Bus #250 along Marine Drive to 25th St.

name: Whytecliff Park Beach
description: Canada's first Marine Protected Area, offering dramatic rocky coves, islet scrambling at low tide, and world-class scuba diving.
parkingInfo: Free lots inside Whytecliff Park (pay parking in summer).
transitInfo: Bus #257 or #250 to Horseshoe Bay, transfer to #262.

name: Sandy Cove Beach
description: A hidden gem tucked between West Vancouver luxury homes with soft sand, rocky bluffs, and tranquil sheltered waters.
parkingInfo: Extremely limited street parking on Marine Drive. Come by transit or bike.
transitInfo: Bus #250 along Marine Drive to Sandy Cove stop.

name: Cates Park / Whey-ah-wichen
description: Tsleil-Waututh ancestral land at the entrance to Indian Arm with totem poles, kayak rentals, concession, and sweeping water views.
parkingInfo: Ample parking lots inside Cates Park off Dollarton Hwy.
transitInfo: Bus #212 from Phibbs Exchange.

name: Deep Cove Beach (Panorama Park)
description: Picturesque fjord community park, launch point for Indian Arm paddle adventures, and home of Honey Doughnuts.
parkingInfo: Paid and free lots in Deep Cove; fills very quickly on sunny mornings.
transitInfo: Bus #211 or #212 directly to Deep Cove from Phibbs Exchange.

name: Kings Mill Walk Dog Beach
description: Popular North Shore waterfront pathway featuring designated off-leash pebble shoreline facing downtown Vancouver skyscrapers.
parkingInfo: Harbourside Drive parking lots and street spots.
transitInfo: SeaBus to Lonsdale Quay, transfer to Bus #236 / #231.

name: Barnet Marine Park (Main Beach)
description: Burnaby's premier saltwater beach overlooking Burrard Inlet and Belcarra, with historic mill ruins, expansive grass lawns, and an off-leash dog beach.
parkingInfo: Large free parking lot off Barnet Highway.
transitInfo: Bus #160 along Barnet Hwy with pedestrian overpass into park.

name: Deer Lake Beach
advisoryReason: Elevated single-sample count (290 CFU/100mL) due to low water movement during hot weather. Caution advised for sensitive swimmers.
description: Cultural heart of Burnaby surrounded by the Shadbolt Centre, art gallery, heritage museum, and watercraft boat rentals.
parkingInfo: Free lots at Deer Lake Park and Shadbolt Centre.
transitInfo: Bus #144 or #133 from Metrotown Station.

name: Sasamat Lake (White Pine Beach)
description: One of Metro Vancouver's warmest freshwater lakes, featuring smooth white sandy shores, floating dock bridges, and forest loop trails.
parkingInfo: Paid summer parking (Parkade / mobile app); lots fill by 10 AM on sunny weekends.
transitInfo: Seasonal Bus #182 or #150 from Coquitlam Central SkyTrain Station.

name: Buntzen Lake (South Beach)
description: Stunning mountain-surrounded reservoir managed by BC Hydro, with expansive main beach, designated dog beach & agility park, and hiking trailheads.
parkingInfo: Free summer day-pass parking reservation required via BC Hydro website.
transitInfo: Bus #182 from Moody Centre or Coquitlam Central Station.

name: Buntzen Lake (North Beach)
description: Boat- or hike-in remote wilderness beach at the north end of Buntzen Lake, with secluded picnic tables and cool mountain water.
parkingInfo: Park at South Beach lot and paddle or hike 5km north.
transitInfo: Transit to South Beach, then paddle or hike.

name: Belcarra Regional Park Beach
description: Sheltered coastal cove along Bedwell Bay featuring a long crabbing pier, forest trails to Jug Island, and kayak launching docks.
parkingInfo: Paid summer parking lots inside Belcarra Regional Park.
transitInfo: Bus #182 from Port Moody Station to Belcarra Bay.

name: White Rock East Beach
description: Warm shallow tidal waters of Semiahmoo Bay with soft sand flats stretching out hundreds of meters at low tide and quiet promenade.
parkingInfo: Pay parking along Marine Drive and East Beach pay lots.
transitInfo: Bus #361 or #362 from South Surrey Park & Ride.

name: White Rock West Beach & Pier
description: The bustling heart of White Rock waterfront featuring Canada's longest pier (470m), gelato shops, fish & chips, and the famous white boulder.
parkingInfo: Paid street parking along Marine Dr and waterfront lots.
transitInfo: Bus #361, #362, or #375 from White Rock Centre.

name: Crescent Beach
description: Historic seaside community in South Surrey with swimming raft, seaside promenade, Blackie Spit bird sanctuary, and dog beach.
parkingInfo: Free lots at Sullivan Point and street parking throughout village.
transitInfo: Bus #350 from White Rock Centre or Bridgeport Station.

name: Iona Beach Regional Park
description: Unique barrier island ecosystem with a 4km jetty extending straight into the Salish Sea, dramatic river delta dunes, and airplane spotting.
parkingInfo: Free parking lot at end of Iona Island Causeway.
transitInfo: Best reached by car or road bike (no direct transit onto island).

name: Garry Point Park Beach
description: Windy, open coastal park at the mouth of the Fraser River in historic Steveston village with rolling dunes, kite flying, and fish & chips.
parkingInfo: Large free parking lot at 7th Ave & Chatham St.
transitInfo: Bus #401, #406, or #407 from Richmond-Brighouse SkyTrain Station.

name: Lions Bay Beach Park
description: Scenic Howe Sound cove in Lions Bay village with floating swimming dock, kayak racks, and dramatic mountain peaks towering overhead.
parkingInfo: Paid parking lot at Lions Bay Marina / Park (strictly enforced).
transitInfo: Bus #262 from Horseshoe Bay.

name: Kelvin Grove Beach
description: Secluded Howe Sound beach south of Lions Bay with designated off-leash dog area, clear emerald waters, and scuba launch point.
parkingInfo: Paid parking lot off Kelvin Grove Way.
transitInfo: Bus #262 from Horseshoe Bay.

name: Sandy Beach (Bowen Island)
description: 5-minute walk from the Snug Cove BC Ferries terminal, featuring gentle sloping sand, driftwood logs, and calm island waters.
parkingInfo: Park in Horseshoe Bay and walk onto ferry, or park in Snug Cove village.
transitInfo: BC Ferry from Horseshoe Bay to Bowen Island (20 min sailing).

name: Bowen Bay Beach
description: West-facing Bowen Island sandy beach with sunset views over Georgia Strait and Vancouver Island mountains.
parkingInfo: Limited roadside parking along Bowen Bay Rd.
transitInfo: Bowen Island community bus #280 from Snug Cove.

name: Centennial Beach (Boundary Bay Regional Park)
description: Renowned as one of the warmest ocean beaches in Canada with huge expanses of tidal sand flats, warm tidal pools, and birding dykes.
parkingInfo: Large free parking lot at Boundary Bay Regional Park.
transitInfo: Bus #604 from South Delta Recreation Centre.
